newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania offers 899.4 bln lei in T-bills in June.
newsitem.headline: Romania offers 899.4 bln lei in T-bills in June.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said on Wednesday it would launch three rollover issues of three-month treasury bills totalling 899.4 trillion lei, to be placed through auctions this month.

The fixed-interest bills with a face value of 10 million lei are offered through a Dutch-style auction with investors allowed to submit only competitive bids. Auctions are to be held two days before the issue date.
The bills are available for commercial banks operating in Romania and their corporate clients. The ministry can decide to increase the T-bill offer in case of oversubscription.
Earlier this year, the finance ministry issued floating rate bills with high-returning annual yields, which peaked at about 300 percent in March.
Yields fell rapidly in recent months to reach 65 percent at the previous auction amid heavy oversubscription and an overliquid money market.
